label: What Scan says when a project's code cannot be reached

params.name: bad_git_url
params.default: That does not look like a Git address. Use https://… or git@…

params.name: bad_branch
params.default: That branch name has characters a branch name cannot have.

params.name: no_git
params.default: git is not installed on this machine, so a Git project cannot be fetched. Install git, or clone the repository yourself and register it as a folder.

params.name: no_folder
params.default: No folder is set for this project. Edit it and give a path, or point it at a Git repository.

params.name: windows_path_on_server
params.default: This portal runs on {system}, and "{path}" is a path on your own Windows computer — the server cannot see it. Point the project at its Git repository instead, or give a path that exists on the server, or add the screens by hand.

params.name: folder_not_found
params.default: The server that runs this portal cannot find "{path}". Remember it looks on ITS OWN disk, not on your computer: use a Git repository, a path that exists on the server, or add the screens by hand.

description_nl: bad_git_url / bad_branch / no_git: a Git project that cannot be fetched. git_failed: {command} and the last line of git's {error} (already scrubbed of tokens); git_failed_blank when git said nothing. pulled / cloned and synced ({note} at {commit}): the line after a fetch. no_folder / folder_not_found ({path}) / windows_path_on_server ({system}, {path}; unknown_system when the server does not say): a local project's folder is missing.

expect_value.bad_git_url: That does not look like a Git address. Use https://… or git@…
expect_value.bad_branch: That branch name has characters a branch name cannot have.
expect_value.no_git: git is not installed on this machine, so a Git project cannot be fetched. Install git, or clone the repository yourself and register it as a folder.
expect_value.no_folder: No folder is set for this project. Edit it and give a path, or point it at a Git repository.
expect_value.windows_path_on_server: This portal runs on {system}, and "{path}" is a path on your own Windows computer — the server cannot see it. Point the project at its Git repository instead, or give a path that exists on the server, or add the screens by hand.
expect_value.folder_not_found: The server that runs this portal cannot find "{path}". Remember it looks on ITS OWN disk, not on your computer: use a Git repository, a path that exists on the server, or add the screens by hand.

weight_basis: Portal business setting of the Training & Video Portal. The knobs ARE the policy — edit them here, never in Python.
